usage.header: usage: node bitbucket.mjs <command> [arguments]   (run inside the repository; every command takes --remote <name> when there are several remotes)
usage.create: create --title <text> [--body <text> | --body-file <path>] [--target <branch>] [--branch <name>] [--dry-run]   push the current branch (HEAD to <name> with --branch) and open a pull request
usage.comment: comment <id> --body <text> | --body-file <path>   comment on a pull request
usage.description-block: description-block <id> --name <marker> --file <path>   put the file's text in a marked block of the description, replacing an earlier block of that name
usage.check: check [--offline] [--json]                 confirm the account resolves and can write pull requests here; prints where it came from, never a token
usage.conventions: conventions [--json]                       list the templates, skills and saved templates this project already has for pull requests
usage.template: template save pr --file <path> [--force] | show pr   keep or print the project's pull request template

args.bodyRequired: Give the text with exactly one of --body <text> or --body-file <path>.
args.badLimit: --limit must be a whole number from 1 to {max}.

check.offline: The Bitbucket API was not called (--offline).
check.scopeMissing: The token has no {scope} (granted: {granted}). Mint one with "Create API token with scopes", app Bitbucket, scope write:pullrequest, or fix the account in Lantern (command palette, Integrations).

block.badName: "{name}" is not a marker name: use lowercase letters, digits, : _ and -, starting with a letter or digit.
block.unreadable: Could not read the block text: {reason}

credentials.missing: Missing {names}. Add the Bitbucket account in Lantern (command palette, Integrations); runs started from Lantern then get it for the project. Nothing else needs to be set up.

reason.noAccount: Lantern has no Bitbucket account yet: add one in Lantern (command palette, Integrations), then choose an account for this project in Integrations.
reason.chooseAccount: No Bitbucket account is chosen for this project: choose an account for this project in Integrations (command palette, Integrations).
reason.storeUnavailable: Lantern could not read the stored account (its secret store is locked or unavailable); unlock it and try again.
reason.unknownProject: This folder is not a project opened in Lantern; open it there.
reason.notRunning: Lantern is not running or does not answer; start it.

hint.401: The account was not accepted; check it in Lantern (command palette, Integrations).
hint.403: The account may lack permission for this (pull requests need the read and write pull request scopes).
hint.404: Not found, or the account cannot see it.

git.detachedHead: Detached HEAD. Check out a branch first.
git.noDefaultBranch: Could not determine the remote's default branch. Pass --target <branch>.
git.sameBranch: Source and target are both "{branch}"; there is nothing to review. Work on a branch or pass --target.
git.dirtyTree: The working tree has uncommitted changes to tracked files. Commit them first.
git.targetMissing: Target branch "{target}" does not exist on {remote}. Ask the user which branch to target.

remote.noneFound: No remote of this repository points at bitbucket.org.

pr.badId: "{id}" is not a pull request number.
pr.titleRequired: Give the pull request a title with --title <text>.

action.lookup: Looking for an open pull request of this branch

pr.title: #{id}: {title}
pr.blockWritten: Wrote the {name} block of pull request #{id}. {url}
pr.exists: Pull request #{id} is already open for this branch; no second one was opened. {url}
pr.dryRun: Dry run, nothing pushed or sent. Would push {source} to {remote} and open a pull request into {target} in {workspace}/{repo}:

conventions.none: Nothing found: no pull request template in the repository, no skill about it and no saved template.
conventions.repoLine: pull request template in the repository
conventions.savedLine: pull request template saved for this project ({kind})

template.badAction: The first argument must be one of: {actions}.
template.badKind: The kind "{kind}" is not one for Bitbucket; use one of: {kinds}.
template.exists: A template is already saved at {path}; pass --force to replace it.
template.absent: No {kind} template is saved for this project.
